synthesis.body: build-check does not resolve relative links in Markdown, and lint-spec-status.py's dangling-reference check is warn-only and covers docs/specs/ alone. So a relocation ADR (ADR-0055 lifting docs/contracts/ and docs/guides/ to repo root) leaves every `](../contracts/...)` and `](../guides/...)` in docs/architecture/ pointing at a deleted directory, and nothing fails. When a doc change touches paths at all, resolve every relative link in the touched files against the actual tree — `(file.parent / target).resolve().exists()` — before claiming the links are fixed. A grep proving the string changed proves only that the string changed. Two related traps in the same pass: (1) links can break by *removal* rather than depth (tools/run-pack-evals.py and tools/lint-agent-artifacts.py were folded into CLI subcommands at v0.13.0), so the resolver finds both classes but they need different fixes; (2) a systemic wrong-depth pattern repeated across a whole tree may be correct in the projected location that tree ships to — check before sweeping.

title: No gate resolves relative Markdown links — a directory move leaves silent 404s for months
